known_data_limitation: Reused authored cases already inspected; supplementary descriptive comparison, not new held-out validation. No reserved outcome used to tune controller.
routing: Original rule_response unchanged. Its single no_action means unrecognised and triggers fallback only for hybrid; recognised clarification/actions retained, including execution-policy failures. No additional invalid-request detector.
measurement: All three conditions execute on SBC through same HTTP wrapper (19121); model calls are local loopback19115. Notebook times complete HTTP response, then executes/evaluates virtual action separately. Model loading/preparation excluded.
failover: Before dispatch only. A dispatched failure/timeout is retained, never silently retried; subsequent tasks may move to unused validated reserve.
manual_review: Original conservative evaluator unchanged; newly pending semantic reviews remain pending, no automatic reuse of prior human judgments.
